description: Start an asynchronous browser readiness check across all approved product demo pages to verify they load and show their expected UI text. Use after deploying website/app changes or fixing failed proof text. Does not approve or publish candidates. Poll demopage_status for results.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Send the same key when you retry the same request: the first result comes back and nothing runs twice. Keys last 24 hours.

name: demopage_check_pages
title: Verify approved demo pages in a live browser
